summary: Read the retained receipt for the blocking probe (CheckRun 8e041cda11284c539f23fc87e776a4d2): event 5 shows NewRaft not returning within 20 s with the blocked goroutine captured inside processLogs' batch send (index 9001) under restoreFromCommittedLogs with no runFSM consumer, while event 3 shows the same path returning in 6 ms for a 94-batch range (and an empty post-restart configuration).
